column3: NASB supplies “of it”; “fallen short” is rendered “come short.”

“We are evangelised” is rendered “we have had good news preached to us”; NASB’s singular “it was not united” refers to the word, while the critical text has the plural participle referring to the hearers.
“Did not enter” is rendered “failed to enter.”
“Appoints” is rendered “fixes”; NASB follows the critical text (“has been said before”).
“Before Him” is rendered “from His sight”; “to whom is our reckoning” is rendered “with whom we have to do.”
NASB supplies “One who” and “as we are”; “in the same way” is rendered “as we are.”
